hypothesis.claim: On the frozen opening 250,000-byte population, setting the existing file-backed PPM residency budget to zero preserves exact clean-control payload bytes while moving scratch to a non-memory-backed filesystem and satisfying resource, inverse, repeat, package, and cleanup gates.
hypothesis.falsification: Reject if either arm lacks a valid terminal receipt, inverse or repeat fails, payload byte count/SHA-256/direct comparison differs, PPM0 is not the only treatment definition, scratch is memory-backed, any process tree exceeds 9,765,625 KiB, allocated scratch exceeds 100,000,000,000 bytes, package delta exceeds 65,536 bytes, or cleanup is incomplete.

changedMechanism: Infrastructure-only: compare a clean disk-scratch build against CMIX_PPMD_RSS_BUDGET_MB=0ULL, which evicts the unchanged file-backed PPM mapping at the existing check interval.
invariants: No context capacity, replacement policy, state byte, probability, preprocessing step, or arithmetic-coder operation changes.
The clean and PPM0 arms use the same source revision, corpus prefix, toolchain family, package boundary, disk helper, and runner accounting.
Encoder, repeat encoder, and bare decoder use the same arm-specific executable and residency policy.
Payload identity requires byte count, SHA-256, and direct durable-file byte comparison; equal size alone is insufficient.
Scratch must be mounted on neither tmpfs nor ramfs.
Every missing receipt or decision field fails closed.
This experiment earns zero compression and objective credit.

controls.definition: Matched clean non-PGO source build with the parent PPM residency policy and disk-backed scratch.
Matched source build with CMIX_PPMD_RSS_BUDGET_MB=0ULL and disk-backed scratch.

population.unit: raw enwik9 bytes encoded through the complete reversible pipeline
population.selection: Frozen opening 250KB infrastructure diagnostic; larger populations require separately frozen contracts.
population.coordinate: Complete cmix-obias pipeline with matched clean and PPM0 source builds.

availableInformation: Current process RSS and the existing fixed PPM purge check.
The file-backed PPM heap containing decoder-visible modeled state.
Disk mount metadata and allocated scratch accounting.
forbiddenInformation: Future corpus symbols or encoder-only model state.
Any context-table capacity, modeled-state, probability, or coder change.
Memory-backed scratch represented as disk compliance.

measurements.definition: Clean and PPM0 restored bytes exactly equal the frozen population.
Each arm's repeated encode produces identical durable payload bytes.
Clean and PPM0 durable payload byte counts and SHA-256 values match and direct chunked comparison is byte-equal.
The only treatment compile definition is CMIX_PPMD_RSS_BUDGET_MB=0ULL.
Every scratch path is non-memory-backed and allocated scratch never exceeds 100,000,000,000 bytes.
Every observed process-tree peak RSS is at most 9,765,625 KiB.
PPM0 incremental required package bytes are at most 65,536.
All bounded scratch is removed and zero attributable bytes remain after cleanup.
